overview_description.description: GovGuard develops AI software that automates public records and FOIA workflows for government agencies. The platform connects to municipal archives, ingesting emails, PDFs, documents, spreadsheets, and multimedia from systems such as Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, and other record repositories. It uses AI agents to search unstructured records, surface responsive documents, and flag or redact sensitive information such as personally identifiable information, trade secrets, and privileged material. GovGuard also generates draft statutory response letters with cited exemptions for clerk and attorney review. The software supports early case assessment by helping legal teams estimate litigation risk and review relevant records internally before engaging outside counsel. GovGuard is designed for city clerks, records officers, and public-sector legal teams seeking to manage FOIA requests, internal investigations, and discovery using a centralized, auditable workflow platform.
